# webtables/bxor

> Bitwise xor: `^`, with `i64.xor`.

truck [webtables](../webtables.md) · [source](../../../registry/webtables/bxor.pkg) · translates [std/bxor](../std/bxor.md)

    WebAssembly evaluates the operands left to right, as bintables does.

## Emit variants

The first variant whose condition holds is used.

### `emit`

```nasm
(i64.xor
{left}
{right}
)
```
